name: FMJ
summary: Ammo Type - shown in game as Standard.

beginner.whatItIs: The default round every weapon starts with. The game calls it Standard in the buy menu.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is the round you already own and never have to unlock, and it is the baseline the other two are measured against.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it until you have a reason not to. Against an unarmoured target it is doing most of what the alternatives do, for none of the money.

name: HP
summary: Ammo Type - shown in game as Flesh.

beginner.whatItIs: A round tuned for hitting people who are not wearing plates. The buy menu calls it Flesh.
beginner.whyItMatters: It rewards you for winning the fight you were already winning, and punishes you for meeting someone in armour with it.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Carry it when your fights are against lightly kitted players. Switch off it the moment the other side is running plates.

name: AP
summary: Ammo Type - shown in game as Piercing.

beginner.whatItIs: The armour-piercing round, shown as Piercing in the buy menu, and the last of the three to become available - its gates run from level 63 to level 140. The source has not confirmed what it costs.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is the only one of the three that still does its job through heavy armour, which is why the game puts it behind the highest level gate on almost every calibre.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Load it when you expect armoured opposition and can afford to be wrong. Do not pay for it while your fights are against fresh spawns.

beginner.whatItIs: A fourth ammunition type that only 12 Gauge gets. Where the other shotgun loads throw a spread of pellets, this one sends a single solid projectile down the barrel.
beginner.whyItMatters: It changes what the gun is rather than how hard it hits. A shotgun firing one projectile stops losing its damage to spread at distance, so the same weapon stays useful past the doorway range it is normally stuck at - and no other calibre in the game has an option that does this.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Once you reach WARDOG level 41, which is where it opens. Take it when you like your shotgun but keep dying to people standing thirty metres away; stay on the standard load while all your fights are indoors. The unlock price is not published yet, so budget for a surprise.
